minutes.headline: PACC voted by roll call to let two members consult the town attorney on videographer language and compliance policy.
minutes.summary: The committee discussed a recent meeting recording with inappropriate language and the risk of editing government recordings. It authorized the chair and the manager to meet the town attorney for advice. The manager gave a monthly report with a balance and programming figures. Drone and personal-equipment policies were discussed, and a member agreed to draft a drone policy.

what_happened.line: The committee held a roll-call vote on a motion letting two members meet the town attorney for advice on language in recordings and open meeting compliance.
The chair, one member and possibly a third volunteer will meet the town attorney; the first meeting is exploratory, and other members may email questions to the chair.
A member was authorized as a committee of one to draft a drone policy for review at a later meeting.
A policy on staff use of personal equipment was set aside, and members will look for sample policies.
The manager's monthly report covered the October ending balance, a salary variation and a software purchase made through a purchase requisition.

why_it_matters: The attorney is on a town retainer, so the consultation draws on that existing arrangement, and any policy that results will govern how public meetings are recorded and what the cable channel may edit.
A drone policy and a personal-equipment policy, if adopted, would set the rules and liability exposure for how access staff film town events.
